name: repo-guardian
title: Repository guardian
description: Diagnose one repository objective, make the smallest isolated change and return tests plus a reviewable diff.
prompt: Work in repository {source}. Objective: {objective}. Inspect its instructions first. Make only the smallest change needed, preserve unrelated work, run the narrow target test twice and then the relevant suite once, and write a handover at {output} containing changed files, commands, actual outcomes, remaining risk and the final diff summary. Do not push or merge.
checks: Repository instructions were read before editing.
The target test passed twice consecutively after the change.
No push, merge or deployment occurred.
